skill.name: tiktok-verified-mention-tracker
skill.description: Find public TikTok mentions through an Apify Actor, distinguish clickable tags from caption mentions, and retrieve post details and engagement metrics.
skill.summary: Configure and run an Apify workflow for public TikTok mention research.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 68 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, JavaScript templates, intended input reads, documented configuration access, and expected Apify requests. No evidence found of prompt injection, unauthorized credential disclosure, or destructive behavior in the reviewed files. The remote Actor implementation is not included, so its behavior remains outside this audit.

content.value_statement: TikTok search results can mix clickable account tags, plain caption mentions, and unrelated matches. This skill configures an Apify workflow that labels matches and returns public post details.
actual_capabilities: Accept TikTok handles, @handles, or profile links through the documented Actor input.
Configure the Actor to return clickable tags, caption mentions, or all labeled search results.
Set date, minimum view, country, ordering, and per-account or overall result filters.
Submit JSON input from a local file or inline argument through the bundled Node.js runner.
Retrieve dataset rows with post links, captions, author details, and engagement counts through Apify.
Provide curl examples for synchronous execution, asynchronous run creation, status checking, and dataset retrieval.
limitations: Requires network access, an Apify token, and paid Actor usage; the bundled runner also requires Node.js 18 or later.
Mention detection runs in an external Actor whose implementation is not included; local files cannot independently establish its accuracy.
TikTok search coverage is incomplete and varies by country; deep search and related-video discovery require more time and memory.
Only public data is supported; the bundled runner has no scheduling, CSV conversion, or asynchronous polling loop.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a First Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a search for public mentions of [handle], limited to three posts. Explain the Apify requirements before running it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: configure a small initial request.

prompt_templates.title: Find Clickable Tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Find only clickable TikTok tags of [brand] from the past week. Exclude its own posts and limit results to 20.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: separate structured account tags from caption text.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Account Mentions
prompt_templates.prompt: Search public mentions of [handle A] and [handle B] in [country]. Sort by likes, require 1,000 views, and cap results at 50 total.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine account, country, engagement, and result filters.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Deep Research Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a deep search for [handles] after [date], with 100 results maximum. Propose memory and asynchronous execution steps; obtain approval before paid execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: plan a larger bounded run with explicit cost approval.

This explanation is illustrative and does not report a live search.

best_practices: Start with a small total result limit and review Actor pricing before approving paid execution.
Use the clickable-tag filter when structured mentions matter, and inspect mentionType before interpreting results.
Keep tokens in environment variables; submit only public account inputs and review applicable terms and laws.
anti_patterns: Treating caption matches or broad search results as verified clickable tags or complete mention coverage.
Passing cookies, session credentials, or private account information into the search input.
Launching deep searches, related-video discovery, or downloads without checking cost, memory, and storage requirements.

faq.question: What does verified mean here?
faq.answer: It refers to distinguishing clickable account tags from caption text. It does not mean the mentioned account has a verification badge.

faq.question: Does the default filter return only clickable tags?
faq.answer: No. The default taggedOrCaption filter includes clickable tags and plain @handle captions. Use tagged to request clickable tags only.

faq.question: What do I need to run the skill?
faq.answer: You need an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, and network access. The bundled script requires Node.js 18 or later, and Actor usage is billed.

faq.question: Can it access private TikTok posts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to public data and explicitly prohibits passing cookies, sessions, or private account data.

faq.question: Does it run entirely on my computer?
faq.answer: No. The local runner sends selected input to Apify, where an external Actor performs the search and provides dataset results.

faq.question: Does it export CSV or monitor accounts continuously?
faq.answer: The runner prints JSON for one synchronous request. CSV conversion, scheduling, and repeated monitoring require additional tooling.
